chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked: “What is the definition of good character?”
He عليه السلام said: “It is that you be gentle in your manner, make your speech pleasant, and meet your brother with a cheerful face.”

key_terms.بِبِشْرٍ حَسَنٍ: with a cheerful and pleasant expression
key_terms.تُطِيبُ كَلَامَكَ: to make one’s speech pleasant and kind
key_terms.تُلِينُ جَانِبَكَ: to be gentle and soft in one’s manner
key_terms.حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ: good character; noble and beautiful conduct

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام define good character?
ai.summary: This hadith defines good character through three outward qualities: gentleness, pleasant speech, and meeting others with a cheerful expression. It presents akhlaq as something visible in conduct and social interaction, especially in how one treats a fellow believer.
